transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been feeling really down and have completely lost interest in all my hobbies. I just don't have the motivation to do anything anymore. It's been going on like this for about a year and a half now.
Have you ever experienced a period of time, no matter how brief, where you felt abnormally happy, irritable, or had increased energy, or where you didn't need as much sleep as usual?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I haven't had any periods of feeling abnormally happy, irritable, or full of high energy. It has really just been the opposite for me.
Can you tell me more about your low mood and loss of interest in hobbies - have they been constant over the past year and a half, or have you had some periods where you felt somewhat better?

It has been completely constant, without any breaks or better days. For the entire year and a half, I haven't felt any interest in my hobbies or experienced any real improvement. Every day just feels the same, flat and heavy.
How have you been able to manage your daily life and responsibilities, such as work or school, and social relationships, despite feeling this way for the past year and a half?

Managing everything has been incredibly difficult because I have absolutely no motivation to start or finish tasks at work, and I feel completely indifferent to any of my achievements. I've also withdrawn from my friends and family, putting almost no effort into maintaining any of my relationships over the last year and a half.
Can you estimate how many days out of the week you have felt this low, and have you experienced significant weight loss or gain, changes in appetite, or sleep disturbances during this time?

I've felt this low almost every single day for the past year and a half, though my weight and appetite haven't really changed. However, my sleep is completely ruined—I struggle to fall asleep, wake up constantly throughout the night, and wake up too early, though sometimes I end up sleeping for huge blocks of time. Even then, I have awful nightmares and always wake up feeling exhausted and unrefreshed.

Have you experienced any periods of at least two weeks where your depressive symptoms were particularly severe, such as feeling hopeless, worthless, or having recurring thoughts of death, or have your symptoms been consistently at a lower level of severity throughout the year and a half?

I haven't really experienced extreme feelings like hopelessness, worthlessness, or thoughts of death. Instead, my struggles with my lack of motivation, loss of interest, and sleep issues have been relatively consistent at the same level throughout the entire year and a half.
For how long at a time can you say you've felt relatively okay, or at least not as bad, even if it was just for a few days, over the course of the past year and a half?

I'm not really sure, and I haven't thought about it much. It feels like it has been pretty constantly difficult without any clear periods of feeling okay over the last year and a half. It has just been a continuous struggle.

Can you think of any times, even if brief, where you might have felt a slight lift in your mood or a bit more interest in things, or has it been a completely unbroken stretch of feeling down and unmotivated for the entire year and a half?

It has been a completely unbroken stretch of feeling down and unmotivated for the entire year and a half. I haven't experienced any brief lifts in my mood or even a temporary moment of interest in anything. It has just been completely continuous without any relief at all.
Did your low mood and loss of interest in activities start after a significant life event or stressor, or did they seem to begin without any clear precipitating factor?
I'm not really sure, and I don't recall any specific major event or stressor triggering these feelings. It seemed to just gradually develop about a year and a half ago without any clear cause.

Can you think back to the time when you first started feeling this way, about a year and a half ago - was there anything unusual or out of the ordinary happening in your life around that time, even if it seems insignificant now?

I've definitely been feeling this way for about a year and a half now. However, looking back, I really don't recall any unusual events, stressors, or changes happening in my life around the time it all started.
